description: Internal Bluetooth Low Energy scan management functions and macros for the Nordic Semiconductor ULL implementation.

methods.name: ull_scan_params_set
methods.description: Sets scan parameters such as type, interval, window, and filter policy.

methods.name: ull_scan_enable
methods.description: Enables and starts scanning or initiating role.

methods.name: ull_scan_set_get
methods.description: Returns the scan set context for a given handle.

methods.name: ull_scan_handle_get
methods.description: Returns the handle for a given scan set instance.

methods.name: ull_scan_is_valid_get
methods.description: Checks and returns if a scan context is valid.

methods.name: ull_scan_is_enabled_get
methods.description: Returns the scan set if enabled.

methods.name: ull_scan_is_disabled_get
methods.description: Returns the scan set if disabled.

methods.name: ull_scan_filter_pol_get
methods.description: Returns the filter policy used for scanning.

methods.name: ull_scan_aux_set_get
methods.description: Returns auxiliary scan set instance for a handle.

methods.name: ull_scan_aux_is_valid_get
methods.description: Checks if auxiliary scan context is valid.
